hotels.title: Iconic Victoria Harbourfront Luxury at Fairmont Empress
hotels.description: Overlooking Victoria’s Inner Harbour, this grand Edwardian landmark pairs heritage detailing with polished contemporary comforts. The hotel sits beside the Royal BC Museum and a short stroll from the Parliament Buildings, with the boutiques and galleries of Government Street close byAfternoon tea is served in the Lobby Lounge, while Q at the Empress showcases Pacific Northwest produce and local seafood. The spa offers treatments inspired by Vancouver Island botanicals, and the harbourfront path leads towards Fisherman’s Wharf and the colourful floatplanes
